CSE Shariah Index revised

Dhaka, November 13, 2024: The CSE Shariah Index (CSI) has been reviewed and revised on the basis of the performance of the CSE-listed companies. The new index will be effective from November 25, 2024. CSE Shariah index (CSI) is reviewed twice a year.

 

No new company has been included in CSE Shariah Index (CSI). On the other hand, 3 companies i.e., Heidelberg Cement Bangladesh Ltd., Regent Textile Mills Limited and Ratanpur Steel Re-Rolling Mills Limited, were excluded from the previous list. 

 

In the revised CSE Shariah Index, 123 listed companies out of 384 listed Companies have been selected. These are-aamra Networks Limited, aamra Technologies Ltd., Acme Pesticides Limited, ADN Telecom Limited, Advent Pharma Limited, AFC Agro Biotech Limited, Agni Systems Limited, Al-Arafah Islami Bank PLC., Alif Industries Limited, Aman Cotton Fibrous Limited, Ambee Pharmaceuticals PLC, Anwar Galvanizing Limited, Apex Foods Limited,  Apex Spinning & Knitting Mills, Asiatic Laboratories Limited, Associated Oxygen Ltd., Bangas Limited, Bangladesh Building Systems PLC., Baraka Patenga Power Ltd., Baraka Power Limited, Bata Shoe Company (Bd) Limited, BBS Cables PLC., BDCOM Online Limited, BD.
